_note: RTL8721F 所有列出外设均支持任意 pinmux；未列出的外设不受支持；system_reserved 引脚被片内 Flash/PSRAM 占用，不可用于用户代码

pwm.note: Each timer has 4 channels (0-3), 1 pin per channel. Lua: pwm.new({timer_idx=4..7, channel=0..3, pin=..., freq=...})

ir.note: Single hardware block; TX and RX are mutually exclusive. Lua: ir.new(tx_pin, rx_pin)

audio.note: Input: DMIC via dmic_clk_pin+dmic_data_pin. Output: I2S SPORT0 via bclk_pin+ws_pin+dout_pin. Lua: audio.new_input() / audio.new_output()

rtc.note: Internal RTC peripheral, no external pins required. Lua: require('rtc')
